limitations: The original baseline/current pair and fresh current/baseline followup are preserved separately. Their concatenated order is descriptive ABBA; the intervening review and observation gap prevents a controlled uninterrupted ABBA claim.

Throughput is summed acknowledged successes divided by summed drain-inclusive stage elapsed. Counters per success use summed raw counters divided by summed successes. Percent changes are recomputed from these aggregates, never averaged from pair percentages.
Each run's p95 is a histogram upper bound. Aggregate p95 fields retain the range of those run bounds; no pooled percentile is estimated.

Fixture identity, resources, configuration, build and instrumentation continuity do not establish equal cache state, thermal state or absence of all background work. These results do not prove a causal explanation for the original regression.
Observer windows include cluster/background work and differ from workload stage windows. VM and RocksDB counters are not physical SSD IOPS or RustFS backend I/O.
These four instrumented 100-client runs do not establish 10,000-client production capacity or crash/power-loss durability.
